svg.title: LegalGPT Nepal
svg.desc: Final-Year Project · Team Of 4. RAG legal advisor for the Constitution and laws of Nepal: a QLoRA-tuned Mistral Nemo 12B, pgvector retrieval, FastAPI WebSocket streaming and cited answers. I led legal data collection, testing and docs.
